offline_boundary_analysis.probe_scope: Isolated local Electron 43.6.0 BrowserWindow with memory partition, synthetic loopback WebSocket server, no PDD/Titan connection, no production bootstrap, no AI/database/send.
observed_binding_facts: The Electron Debugger message event supplies method, params, and sessionId.
The local root target produced sessionId = empty string in the probe; each WebContents has its own Debugger instance.
Network.webSocketCreated gives requestId, URL, and an optional script initiator.
WebSocket frame events give requestId but no document generation, frameId, platform timestamp, or platform identity.
The frame timestamp is MonotonicTime (seconds since an arbitrary point), not a platform business occurrence time.
WebSocketFrame represents an entire WebSocket message; opcode 1 payloadData is text and other opcodes are base64 binary strings.
No event proves that the socket belongs to the active document generation; Main must establish that mapping at attach/connection time and invalidate it on navigation.
connection_and_document_binding_model: Attach a separate Debugger to the exact WebContents owned by each PddViewHost/session.
Record the WebContents object, session id, and active document generation at observer start.
On webSocketCreated, bind requestId/URL to that observer only if the URL matches the approved Titan origin and the observer is current.
Maintain connectionId/requestId to the original WebContents and document generation; do not replace the binding when a later frame arrives.
On did-start-navigation or equivalent Main lifecycle boundary, invalidate old connection bindings before/at document generation change.
Reject any frame whose requestId was not bound before the current generation, whose observer is detached, or whose WebContents no longer owns the session.

lifecycle_rules.reload: Increment/invalidate document generation at Main navigation start; frames for pre-reload requestIds are discarded even if delivered later.
lifecycle_rules.delayed_old_connection_events: Do not use a frame timestamp or current generation lookup to repair an old connection; use the connection binding created when the socket was observed.
lifecycle_rules.dispose_recreate: Destroy the old Debugger observer/connection map; new WebContents and new generation start with an empty binding map.
lifecycle_rules.destroyed_webcontents: Treat close/destruction as terminal; detach or discard observer state and never route queued frames.
lifecycle_rules.debugger_detach: The Electron Debugger detach event is terminal for that observer; dispatch no further frames and require a new attach/bind cycle.
lifecycle_rules.ownership_unknown: Discard or STOP. Never use payload shop/session/generation as authority.

terminology_clarification.debugger_session_id: The Debugger message event sessionId identifies the attached CDP session. It was empty for the root local target and is not a WebSocket connection ID.
terminology_clarification.request_id: Network RequestId identifies a network request/WebSocket connection. It is not a platform message ID or internal conversation identity.
terminology_clarification.websocket_frame: CDP WebSocketFrame represents an entire WebSocket message, not a browser frame or a fragmented wire frame. It can contain text or base64 binary payloadData.
terminology_clarification.document_generation: Main document generation is application-owned and was not present in the observed CDP WebSocket parameters.

source_findings.production_composition: createMainContext constructs PddPlatformService without resolveInboundScope, resolveInboundIdentity, or onCanonicalInbound. Worker-backed composition supplies workspaceMerchant, StoreRepository, and PlatformAccountRepository but no PDD ingress resolver or collector.
source_findings.observer_attach_timing: PddPlatformService.activate creates the view and calls onViewCreated before production load. PddSessionHost sends the document observation only after dom-ready; PddPageRuntime then starts and may emit page_ready. No production Main-owned WebSocket observer is attached.
source_findings.readiness_source: PddSessionHost.createInboundIngressContext requires status READY. Production READY is established by page_ready from PddPageRuntime after domHealth passes PDD_SELECTOR_PROFILE. Required selector provenance is DESIGN, so READY is not proven PDD authentication or real session-health truth.
source_findings.canonical_caller: handleTrustedInboundIngress is currently called only by tests and the diagnostic proof, not by production composition.
source_findings.legacy_path: index.ts registers pdd-page-ipc with sender, but its callback drops sender. PddPlatformService.handlePageEvent routes by payload session_id or shop_id and independently invokes handleInbound, which may call onInboundMessage or PddOrchestratorBridge.
source_findings.page_ipc_validator: pdd-page-ipc accepts the event when eventValidator is unavailable; this is fail-open if the legacy path is reused.
source_findings.document_binding: PddSessionHost binds a Main-only context object to view, sender, active document generation, READY, and live WebContents. Revalidation rejects stale/disposed/destroyed contexts.
source_findings.canonical_fields: runtimeShop is derived from the trusted document binding; merchant/store/platform account require explicit resolvers; customerUid and platformMessageId come from normalized raw payload; association and selected-customer observation are optional; sourceOccurredAt is nullable with diagnostics.
source_findings.authentic_authority_sources: workspaceMerchant is Main-owned; StoreRepository and PlatformAccountRepository are available in worker-backed production. No implemented resolver maps runtime Shop to canonical Store or PlatformAccount, and runtime Shop must not be assumed to be either.

authority_capabilities.workspaceMerchant: Provides a Main-owned stable merchant id and merchant containment only. It does not identify a Store, PlatformAccount, PDD session, runtime shop, or customer.
authority_capabilities.storeRepository: Provides StoreRecord id/merchantId/name/platform lookup and merchant listing. It contains no runtime-shop binding and does not establish that a runtime shop is a Store.
authority_capabilities.platformAccountRepository: Provides PlatformAccountRecord id/merchantId/platform/optional opaque externalRef lookup and merchant listing. It contains no runtime-shop binding and externalRef semantics remain opaque.
authority_capabilities.consequence: A resolver may use these sources only through an explicit Main-owned mapping. Missing or ambiguous mapping must remain UNKNOWN/UNRESOLVED or reject; runtime Shop must not be auto-equated with Store or PlatformAccount.

lifecycle_behavior.navigation: PddSessionHost.beginDocumentLifecycle clears selected-customer observation, increments documentGeneration, and invalidates old context records through generation comparison.
lifecycle_behavior.reauth: AUTH_REAUTH_REQUIRED suppresses selected customer handling; createInboundIngressContext requires READY, so no new canonical context is issued while reauth remains latched.
lifecycle_behavior.detach_destroy: The diagnostic observer terminates the WebContents lifecycle and removes listeners. PddSessionHost additionally checks READY and isDestroyed before context creation and revalidation.
lifecycle_behavior.dispose_recreate: PddSessionHost.dispose nulls the view, clears selected customer, and sets DISPOSED. The next unit must explicitly create a new WebContents/session rather than reuse a terminated one.
recovery_options: same-WebContents recovery only after a separate Main-owned binding design and live validation (not approved)

recommended_next_acceptance_unit.name: TRUSTED_MAIN_PDD_INGRESS_PRODUCER_WIRING
recommended_next_acceptance_unit.sole_objective: Wire one default-off Main-owned PDD producer from one controlled WebContents into the accepted canonical ingress with explicit scope/identity resolvers and a controlled collector, while keeping the legacy bridge unreachable and production output disabled.
planned_modified_files: apps/desktop/src/main/index.ts (only if a sender-bearing PDD path is selected)
recommended_next_acceptance_unit.main_wiring: Create the Main-owned admission provider and observer in PddPlatformService.activate/onViewCreated. The observer binds connection evidence at Network.webSocketCreated, DROPs every pre-admission frame, and delegates only after session READY, matching session/document binding, actual WebContents equality, and granted Main admission.
recommended_next_acceptance_unit.proposed_interface: Add PddPlatformServiceOptions.createInboundObserver, canonicalIngressMode, and mainAdmissionProvider (default DENY_ALL). Proposed Main method: handleAdmittedInboundIngress(sender, context, admissionId, input). It validates sender and opaque context, evaluates Main admission against actual WebContents/session/document/observer lifecycle, then calls the existing handleTrustedInboundIngress. A frozen connection binding cannot replace the opaque context.
minimum_positive_acceptance: Startup regression proves attach and Network.enable are sent before first load, first load is not blocked on enable resolution, and Network.webSocketCreated is observed after enable.
One controlled WebContents, one synthetic connection, and one text frame reach the real canonical mapper and default validator exactly once.
A same-service second controlled session with equal opaque customer/message IDs remains isolated.
Explicit resolver returns trusted scope or legal UNKNOWN; collector receives only the mapped envelope.
Production composition defaults to DISABLED and enables only through an explicit controlled activation gate.
minimum_negative_acceptance: Awaiting Network.enable before first navigation is forbidden by timeout/regression test.
Observer armed, connection binding valid, and session READY but Main admission missing/denied/throws/stale => canonical ingress and collector calls are zero.
Old page_ready changes session state or receives another page event but cannot grant admission or make the denied result pass.

Connection before observer attach, missing Network.webSocketCreated evidence, pre-admission frame, late attach without creation evidence, old terminal WebContents, same-WebContents restart, wrong CDP session/requestId, stale generation, forged/missing context, and wrong sender all stop before canonical ingress.
Missing resolver, validator unavailable/false/throw, and missing collector stop before legacy fallback.
Collector throw and unsupported Promise return FAILED once with no retry, no AI/send/persistence, and no legacy call.
minimum_failure_acceptance: Observer attach/enable failure cleans up and remains terminal.
Legacy message_received bridge, AI, persistence, and send counters remain zero for all selected-path success and failure cases.
Unknown scope/identity facts remain explicit UNKNOWN/UNRESOLVED and never enable downstream actions.

observed_facts: Healthy order: attach and Network.enable are initiated before first load; did-start-navigation precedes enable resolution; Network.webSocketCreated is observed after enable resolution.
Awaiting Network.enable before first navigation hits the bounded timeout.
Late attach after dom-ready misses Network.webSocketCreated while later handshake/frame events remain observable.
The launcher rejects the sibling old path as PATH_OUTSIDE_REPO and rejects a parent-traversal candidate as NOT_EXACT_PROBE_ROOT before spawning Electron.
inferences: The production onViewCreated hook must return a startup handle without awaiting enable resolution or navigation; activation must await the enable/navigation barrier concurrently.
A connection-created binding cannot be reconstructed after late attach; missing creation evidence must fail closed.
startup_probe.coverage_limitation: This probe validates startup ordering and event visibility only. It does not establish a complete early-message collection design. Under the approved next-unit scope, pre-admission frames are DROPped and disclosed as uncovered.

phase_1_connection_observed_before_ready.evidence: At Network.webSocketCreated, freeze a Main-owned immutable binding record: actual WebContents object, sessionId, shopId, documentGeneration, observer lifecycle, allowed URL/origin, cdpSessionId, requestId, and creation observation time.
phase_1_connection_observed_before_ready.prohibited: Do not call createInboundIngressContext, parse inbound payload, map canonical identity, or write owner/association data at this phase.

phase_2_frame_before_ready.policy: DROP every frame received before independent Main admission. Record a bounded diagnostic reason (for example EARLY_FRAME_WITHOUT_ADMISSION). Do not queue, buffer, release, replay, retry, or map it.
phase_2_frame_before_ready.unobserved_connection: If no Network.webSocketCreated evidence exists for requestId, reject/drop the frame as UNBOUND_OR_STALE_SOURCE; never infer connection identity from current state.
phase_2_frame_before_ready.disclosure: Early messages will not be collected under this controlled unit. This is not a final production message-completeness design.

phase_3_ready_and_canonical_context.policy: After READY, create a canonical context for the exact WebContents and require PddSessionHost.resolveInboundIngressBinding to return the same sessionId, shopId, documentGeneration, and WebContents object as the frozen connection binding.
phase_3_ready_and_canonical_context.mismatch: REJECT/DROP the connection and queued frames; do not refresh or repair identity from current state.
phase_3_ready_and_canonical_context.webContents_equality_verifier: The Main-owned admission provider/service must retain the actual WebContents object from Network.webSocketCreated and compare it by object identity with the sender used for createInboundIngressContext/resolveInboundIngressBinding. The existing resolveInboundIngressBinding result is insufficient by itself because it returns only sessionId, shopId, and documentGeneration.

phase_4_new_frame_after_permission.policy: Only a frame whose requestId was bound at connection creation under the same current lifecycle may be mapped. New frames on an unobserved requestId are dropped.

phase_5_old_events.policy: Old-generation, old-lifecycle, detached, destroyed, or terminal WebContents events are discarded/STOPPED. The old connection is never assigned the current document generation.

legacy_isolation_design.mode: Add an explicit PddPlatformServiceOptions.canonicalIngressMode with production default DISABLED and a separate LEGACY mode only for existing compatibility tests.
legacy_isolation_design.page_state_events: page_ready/login/dom-unsupported may update PddSessionHost state, but they must never create an immutable connection binding or authorize canonical output by themselves.
legacy_isolation_design.legacy_business_events: When canonicalIngressMode is CANONICAL_CONTROLLED or DISABLED, message_received, human_reply_detected, and conversation_changed must not invoke onInboundMessage, PddOrchestratorBridge, AI, persistence, or send.
legacy_isolation_design.initialization: If observer attach or Network.enable has not successfully armed the selected path, canonical admission is false and legacy fallback remains disabled.
legacy_isolation_design.failure: Attach/enable/resolver/validator/mapper/collector failure returns directly; no retry into legacy and no fallback.
legacy_isolation_design.detach_or_termination: Detach/terminal stops the observer, clears bindings, and keeps canonical admission false; page state events cannot re-enable business consumers.

sender_responsibilities.pdd-page-ipc.ts: Receive event.sender, validate trusted WebContents, and call onPageEvent(payload, sender). If the schema validator is unavailable, fail closed instead of forwarding.
sender_responsibilities.main/index.ts: Pass sender through to the service; never invoke handlePageEvent(payload) with payload alone.
sender_responsibilities.pdd-platform-service.ts: Resolve the session by the actual sender object first. A payload session_id/shop_id cannot authorize or mutate another shop session. In canonical/disabled mode, legacy business consumers remain unreachable.

main_admission_contract.ownership: The admission provider is created and owned by Main composition (bootstrap.ts / worker-runtime.ts). Renderer, page events, payload, DOM READY, selected customer, and request IDs cannot create or refresh admission.
main_admission_contract.default: Production default is DENY_ALL. No admission provider means canonical output is denied.
proposed_types: PddMainAdmissionRequest { webContents: WebContents; sessionId: string; shopId: string; documentGeneration: number; observerLifecycleId: number; connectionEvidenceHash: string }
PddMainAdmissionDecision = { granted: true; admissionId: string } | { granted: false; reason: string }
main_admission_contract.proposed_service_method: handleAdmittedInboundIngress(sender, context, admissionId, input, request): PddInboundIngressResult
validation: Validate trusted sender and opaque PddInboundIngressContext first.
Call PddMainAdmissionProvider.evaluate with the actual WebContents, sessionId, shopId, documentGeneration, observer lifecycle, and immutable connection evidence.
Require granted=true and a live admissionId before calling the existing handleTrustedInboundIngress(sender, context, input).
Recheck actual WebContents equality, session/document binding, observer lifecycle, and admission validity before canonical ingress and immediately before collector.
main_admission_contract.denied_or_failed_behavior: Missing, denied, thrown, or stale admission returns STOPPED/REJECTED with canonical ingress and collector counts zero; no legacy fallback, retry, or refresh.
main_admission_contract.page_event_rule: page_ready and other page/renderer state events may update only the sender-owned session state; they cannot grant, refresh, or extend admission.
main_admission_contract.request_binding: The fifth request parameter carries the frozen PddMainAdmissionRequest (actual WebContents, immutable connection evidence, and current document binding); it is not a substitute for the opaque PddInboundIngressContext.
